name: XLA_EVENTS
description: This table contains all information related to a specific event. This table is created as a type XLA_ARRAY_EVENT_TYPE.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the categorization of accounting events that is unique within an application and event class.

columns.name: FILE_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: File Name or OCI object storage identifier of the data file  using which the transaction is created.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the ledger for which the accounting event is created.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an event type and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: EVENT_DATE
columns.description: Date when an accounting event is created.

columns.name: ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Internal identified of the entity.

columns.name: EVENT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Short name of the status associated with the accounting entries generated for this event.

columns.name: PROCESS_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Abbreviated code that tracks the status of generated accounting entries.

columns.name: DATA_SET_NAME
columns.description: Used to identify a set of events to be processed by a specific Create Accounting process. Events with a data set can still be processed by a generic Create Accounting process, but they can also be processed by a Create Accounting process submitted for just the specific data set that contains them.

columns.name: REFERENCE_NUM_1
columns.description: Additional reference (Number).

columns.name: REFERENCE_NUM_2
columns.description: Additional reference (Number).

columns.name: REFERENCE_NUM_3
columns.description: Additional reference (Number).

columns.name: REFERENCE_NUM_4
columns.description: Additional reference (Number).

columns.name: REFERENCE_CHAR_1
columns.description: Additional reference (Character).

columns.name: REFERENCE_CHAR_2
columns.description: Additional reference (Character).

columns.name: REFERENCE_CHAR_3
columns.description: Additional reference (Character).

columns.name: REFERENCE_CHAR_4
columns.description: Additional reference (Character).

columns.name: REFERENCE_DATE_1
columns.description: Additional reference (Date).

columns.name: REFERENCE_DATE_2
columns.description: Additional reference (Date).

columns.name: REFERENCE_DATE_3
columns.description: Additional reference (Date).

columns.name: REFERENCE_DATE_4
columns.description: Additional reference (Date).

columns.name: EVENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifying number of an accounting event.

columns.name: ON_HOLD_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicates whether the event is on hold or not.  Possible values are: Y for Yes, and N for No.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: UPG_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the upgrade batch.

columns.name: UPG_SOURCE_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of the Upgrading application.

columns.name: UPG_VALID_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if Validation was successfully run for the batch.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Date when a business transaction occurred, often involving the exchange of items or value.

columns.name: BUDGETARY_CONTROL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if it is a budgetary control event.

columns.name: MERGE_EVENT_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of merge event set.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: HAS_WARNINGS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether an event has a warning message resulted from the accounting processing.

columns.name: PARTITION_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Partition grouping information, when combined with the period, determines the database partition in which this journal will be stored.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period name of the transaction date. It is used only for archive and purge process. It may not be the same as the accounting entry period name for this event.
